description: Choose the scale and kinds a project's claims are written on: 'math' (theorem, lemma, proposition, corollary, conjecture, question; open, paper, computer, lean, refuted, retracted) or 'law' (position, conclusion, risk, obligation; draft, agreed, practice, disputed, outdated). Free while the project has no claims. With claims, carry every status and every kind in use over to one of the new scale's by name — 'statuses' and 'kinds' as JSON objects, e.g. {"open":"draft","paper":"agreed"} and {"theorem":"position"}; ask the person which goes where, never guess. Each claim whose status moves gets a line in its journal with the change of scale and 'reason' as its ground. Nothing is carried into 'lean'. A page's blocks of the other scale's kinds stay boxes on the page and are no longer read into the register. Whoever configures the project (its lead or an administrator) only.

kinds.description: With claims: each kind in use → one of the new scale's, as a JSON object.

reason.description: Why the scale changes — written into the journal of each claim it moves.

statuses.description: With claims: each status in use → one of the new scale's, as a JSON object.
